title: Automatic Sweep: Timing and Processing of Nightly Transfers
summary: This document describes Automatic Sweep execution: sweeps initiate at 11:00 PM, when the system evaluates your checking balance and releases the transfer. Eligible excess is moved to the designated savings account; posting times vary by institution. The monthly limit is 60 sweep transfers—after 60, additional sweeps pause until the next month.
